'''2020 TMW Pods Kyle McLean DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kyle McLean]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kyle McLean]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Hunt Down And Destroy The Je McLean.txt |Download]]
